bodyHtml:
This Saturday, June 15 is the first-ever Grassroots Cup hosted by Spindles United FC.

Our first home match in Cohoes is taking place at Lansing Park.

It is the biggest event Spindles has ever hosted.

The Grassroots Cup starts at 3 pm on Saturday. A free event courtesy of Spindles United, there will be a dozen vendors, including 3 food trucks to choose from!

A bouncy house, Spindles face paint, and plenty of soccer for the kids!

As mentioned on our social media, Spindles is raising money to develop youth soccer programs by hosting a PlayStation 5 raffle!

You can purchase your tickets for a chance to win the PS5 here.

There will also be the first-ever Top Bins for Charity. A game where you can pay $1 per shot to get the ball in the top right corner netting.

If you score through the hoop, you win a free t-shirt!

And all the proceeds of the game will be donated to Cohoes Youth Recreational Soccer. So it's a win-win.

The handful of other vendors at the event will also be hosting some of their own raffles and giveaways so be sure to check them out!

You can see the full vendor list here.

Vendors and activities will be open till 7pm.

At 6pm will be the kickoff of Spindles United FC vs. Highlanders in a friendly cup match.

This is the club's chance to finally play in front of the community that has supported us since day one.

This is a Bring Your Own Chair event. So get there early to secure your spot, and enjoy the festivities before kickoff.

We can't wait to see you there!
